.decl current_verified_round(round: symbol, run: symbol, cut: symbol, batch: symbol)
// Require one exact cut. Equally recent receipts with different identities leave it undecided.
// Name both equally recent receipts so a reader can see why no current cut exists.
current_step_safety_check(run, step, cut, obligation, verdict, reason) :-
current_step_safety_check(run, step, cut, obligation, verdict, reason), verdict != "proved".
step_safety_blocked(run, step, cut) :- step_safety_blocker(run, step, cut, _, _).
// A verified round of the current run and cut. A round for an earlier cut authorizes nothing.
step_safety_current_cut(run, cut), verified_round(round, run, cut, batch).
// A step is safe on its own when an admitted round of the current cut has exactly that one member.
// A step checked at an ambiguous latest cut is blocked on that obligation. The ambiguous cut names both
// receipts, so waiting cites them as grounds while no current cut exists.
